## What's Changed

- Bumped version of @opencode-ai/plugin and typescript in package.json.
- Introduced an adaptive account rotation strategy with new AdaptiveTracker class for improved account selection based on health and token metrics.
- Enhanced existing account selection logic to support adaptive strategy, including methods for recording rate limits and successes.
- Added configuration schema for adaptive settings in config/schema.ts.
- Implemented new fetch and rate limit handling to accommodate adaptive strategy.
- Created new files for handling OAuth device flow and token refresh logic.
- Show thinking progress

by @mseptiaan in https://github.com/mseptiaan/opencode-qwencode-oauth/pull/24


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mseptiaan/opencode-qwencode-oauth/compare/v1.0.4...v1.0.5
